name: High Elf
description: Heirs of the mystical Feywild, high elves value magic in all its forms. Even those who do not study spellcraft can manipulate the Weave.

name: Wood Elf
description: The forests are your home. Your keen senses and swift footsteps carry the grace of the natural world.

name: Human
description: Ambitious, inventive, and endlessly adaptable, humans make their mark wherever their journeys take them.

name: Half-Elf
description: Between two worlds, you carry elven grace and human curiosity in equal measure.

name: Drow
description: Raised beneath starless skies, drow carry the elegance of elven ancestry and the keen senses of the Underdark.

name: Dwarf
description: Stout and steadfast, dwarves bring enduring resolve and generations of craftsmanship to their journeys.

name: Halfling
description: Small in stature and generous in spirit, halflings meet a much larger world with courage, curiosity, and remarkable luck.

name: Gnome
description: Quick minds and a love of discovery lead gnomes toward hidden wonders, clever inventions, and unexpected adventures.

name: Tiefling
description: An infernal legacy leaves its mark in curved horns and a sweeping tail. Your future, however, is yours to choose.

name: Half-Orc
description: Broad shoulders, prominent tusks, and formidable endurance speak to an orcish heritage. Deeds define the person who bears it.

name: Githyanki
description: Lean, sharp-featured warriors of the Astral Plane, githyanki combine rigorous martial training with inherited psionic gifts.

name: Dragonborn
description: A scaled muzzle, sweeping horns, and a powerful frame proclaim your draconic ancestry. An elemental breath lies behind your words.

name: Aasimar
description: A celestial spark shines through luminous eyes and golden markings, calling you toward a purpose you must discover for yourself.

name: Goliath
description: Towering descendants of giants, goliaths carry stone-gray skin, striking natural markings, and the strength of the high mountains.
